Attached: 1 image

Beszel v0.19.0 is available! If you use this lightweight server monitor, the new update is packed with features.

Highlights: ZFS pool/dataset monitoring, new alerts for container health (with log excerpts), failed systemd services, and CPU I/O wait. Note: Agents now verify HTTPS certs, so check your self-signed setups.

Release: https://github.com/henrygd/beszel/releases/tag/v0.19.0
Run it: https://pikapods.com/pods?run=beszel

#opensource #selfhosted
